name: SampleCollection Feature
abstract: This building block defines a GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing a SOSA SampleCollection, using the properties defined in the SampleCollection Properties schema.
description:
## SOSA SampleCollection Feature

This building block defines a GeoJSON FeatureCollection wrapping [SampleCollection Properties](../../properties/sampleCollection/).

examples.title: Example of a nested SOSA SampleCollection Feature
examples.content:
From the SOSA/SSN specification's SampleCollection test dataset (SC1), as a GeoJSON
FeatureCollection. Unlike ObservationCollection, Sample/Sampling have no property
that structurally distinguishes a leaf instance from a nested collection (no
equivalent of Observation's required `hasResult`/`hasSimpleResult`), so nesting
here is expressed entirely through `properties.hasMember` rather than the
`features` array, to avoid an ambiguous match.

$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema

type: object
allOf:
- $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/bblocks/annotated-schemas/geo/json-fg/featureCollection-lenient/schema.yaml
- type: object
  properties:
    properties:
      $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/ogcapi-sosa/build/annotated/sosa/properties/sampleCollection/schema.yaml
      x-jsonld-id: '@nest'
    features:
      type: array
      items:
        oneOf:
        - $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/ogcapi-sosa/build/annotated/sosa/features/sample/schema.yaml
        - allOf:
          - $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/bblocks/annotated-schemas/geo/json-fg/feature-lenient/schema.yaml
          - type: object
            properties:
              properties:
                $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/ogcapi-sosa/build/annotated/sosa/properties/sampleCollection/schema.yaml
                x-jsonld-id: '@nest'
        - type: string
      x-jsonld-id: http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/hasMember
      x-jsonld-type: '@id'
